description:
## [1.5.0](https://github.com/vippium/brokenn-patches/compare/v1.4.1...v1.5.0) (2026-11-23)

### ✨ New Features
* **jiohotstar:** add `Disable notification permission prompt` patch ([5181f38](https://github.com/vippium/brokenn-patches/commit/5181f3880e889a28e92216086706e3332b8beaef))
* **jiohotstar/hide player buttons:** hide the top bar buttons ([08da74c](https://github.com/vippium/brokenn-patches/commit/08da74c352f0d0fce55ecb1da49cee3d50690e0c))
* **jiohotstar/feed filter:** add `Feed filter` patch that removes home feed trays by title ([e3fd704](https://github.com/vippium/brokenn-patches/commit/e3fd704dff9e018b861a4d623029ceeee852bd17))
* **jiohotstar/brokenn settings:** add a hidden settings page with runtime toggles ([e4b25c7](https://github.com/vippium/brokenn-patches/commit/e4b25c794fa595bd04da8b36bc94bff7425a18da))

### 🔧 Improvements
* **dependencies:** update morphe-gradle-plugin to 2.1.1 ([e2780e8](https://github.com/vippium/brokenn-patches/commit/e2780e86f30c469ed225ba8b668a5511de20506d))
* **dependencies:** update morphe-patcher to 2.5.0 ([87def26](https://github.com/vippium/brokenn-patches/commit/87def26b574591e75b305b046f36460f6fff46d7))

### ♻️ Refactored
* **jiohotstar/Remove ChatGPT AI assistant:** refactored to cover remaining entry points ([3281a7c](https://github.com/vippium/brokenn-patches/commit/3281a7c417390e7931dff0e3d27ec5cfda3fbcf3))
* **jiohotstar/brokenn settings:** move settings access from the Home tab to the My Space tab ([670ad2a](https://github.com/vippium/brokenn-patches/commit/670ad2a02acbcf2a4b0d078f9f1ee9f59e89ab23))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* **jiohotstar/Remove ads:** removed ad markers on the seekbar ([d1437d1](https://github.com/vippium/brokenn-patches/commit/d1437d170afc5b6471a717da8b2e69d37501f011))
* **jiohotstar:** cancel the pending profile tap when another tab is tapped ([dd6c194](https://github.com/vippium/brokenn-patches/commit/dd6c19438d8f15779e6b5f2164b11629fa24d349))
* **octogram/unlock premium:** stop showing the premium badge on non-premium users ([4d1518f](https://github.com/vippium/brokenn-patches/commit/4d1518fc6d5e91a2b0304384c4adb9e81e30cb43))
* **jiohotstar/brokenn settings:** declare vibrate and handle predictive back ([68ee113](https://github.com/vippium/brokenn-patches/commit/68ee113c163e5211c67289e18560bcfe49cb0a38))

patches.name: Bypass VPN check
patches.description: Skips the network interface check that blocks the app on a VPN or proxy.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Turns off Firebase Analytics collection and Crashlytics reporting.

patches.name: Disable update prompt
patches.description: Skips the launch version check that shows the update dialog.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes banner, native, interstitial and rewarded ads.

patches.name: Remove unused permissions
patches.description: Removes phone state, advertising id, install referrer and badge permissions.

patches.name: Skip login
patches.description: Treats the app as signed in and never shows the login screen.

patches.name: Add Brokenn settings
patches.description: Adds a hidden settings page, opened by double-tapping the Profile tab button.

patches.name: Bypass signature check
patches.description: Bypasses app signature verification to allow API access.

patches.name: Disable notification permission prompt
patches.description: Disables the recurring notification permission nag shown every few app launches enabled from My Space.

patches.name: Enable all codecs
patches.description: Unlocks H.265, VP9, AV1 and 4K playback on capable devices.

patches.name: Enable screen mirroring
patches.description: Allows playback while screen mirroring or HDMI is connected.

patches.name: Enable screenshots
patches.description: Allows screenshots and screen recording, including during playback. Will not work on DRM-protected content (Widevine L1).

patches.name: Feed filter
patches.description: Removes selected home feed trays by title, configured in Brokenn settings

patches.name: Force HDR10
patches.description: Enables HDR10 and HDR10+ playback on compatible devices.

patches.name: Hide player buttons
patches.description: Hides selected buttons from the video player.

patches.name: Hide watch page elements
patches.description: Hides selected tabs and sponsored elements from the watch page.

patches.name: Monochrome icon support
patches.description: Adds a themed-icon version of the launcher icon for Android 13+.

patches.name: Premium unlock
patches.description: Unlocks premium UI features, removes subscription nudges, and enables downloads.

patches.name: Remove ChatGPT AI assistant
patches.description: Strips out the integrated ChatGPT AI module entirely.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes pre-roll, mid-roll, live-match and home-feed ads.

patches.name: Remove top bar switcher
patches.description: Removes the JioHotstar/Tadka switcher from the top of Home and snaps the header expand/collapse on tab switches.

patches.name: Anti-delete messages
patches.description: Prevents server-deleted messages from being removed locally.

patches.name: Anti-disappearing media
patches.description: Keeps view-once and self-destructing media viewable forever.

patches.name: Bypass content restrictions
patches.description: Bypasses restricted-content gates and channel no-forward checks.

patches.name: Enable premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium feature UI and shows the premium badge on self only.

patches.name: Hide typing indicator
patches.description: Prevents typing status from being sent to other users.

patches.name: Remove sponsored messages
patches.description: Stops sponsored messages from being fetched and shown in channels.

patches.name: AMOLED theme
patches.description: Makes dark mode pure black for AMOLED screens. Light mode stays normal.

options.description: Hex color to use for AMOLED (e.g. #FF000000 pure black, #FF0A0A0A near-black).
Also force the status bar background to AMOLED on dark themes.
Also force the navigation bar background to AMOLED on dark themes.
Also blacken Material3 surface container colors (recommended for full AMOLED).

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium and removes Family-apps promos from the About screens.
